I have been farming maize for many years and I know this rented land needs fertilizer if I want a good harvest, but I will not waste money on chemicals since this is not my own plot. Last season my neighbor used improved seed and NPK 20-10-10 on his maize and I saw the difference in the size of the cobs, so I will do the same this year. I will work this plot with my wife and children, and when the weeding and harvest come I will hire some young men from the village because 2.59 hectares is too much for us alone. We depend on the rain here, so I will not irrigate.
